name: real-11-smaller-questions
what: Small things only the real program can answer: what the model is sent for the prompt on stdin; what the originator variable changes; whether --json differs from --experimental-json; what an empty stdin does and whether the program waits for stdin to end; whether the program's shell finds ripgrep (rg) when the caller has not put the package's codex-path folder on PATH, as the SDK does for its pinned binary; and (Windows) which system names a turn's environment must hold for the program to work at all.
